text: The authors describe a multi-turn interaction in which each LM is prompted with the earlier turns, continuing until the examiner has no further questions and gives its final decision, organised in three stages each guided by a specific prompt. In the first (setup) stage the examiner is given its role and the examinee's claim and asked to generate questions for the examinee.
title: Three-stage cross-examination: setup questions, follow-ups, factuality decision
